name: textoverlay-videomasking
title: Text Overlay Video Mask
blurb: Video plays through text mask creating text-shaped reveal effect.
description: An autoplay video with text overlaid via SVG mask element. Text acts as a mask cutout allowing video to display through text shape, with background fill in non-text areas.
use_when: Hero sections or featured content with artistic text-as-video-mask reveal effects.
avoid_when: When text readability is needed; masking makes text function as video shape, not readable text.
a11y: Autoplay video without captions or transcript; SVG mask text is not accessible to screen readers.
